American Sign Language.reason: referred to as the language of the EmoSign dataset mentioned in related work, not used in the paper's experiments

Japanese Sign Language.reason: referred to as the sign language used for data collection, recordings, and all experiments, forming the core dataset

British Sign Language.reason: referred to as the source of a pre‑training dataset (BBC Oxford BSL) used only for initialization, not the study focus

English.reason: referred to as the language of subtitles and translation for text inputs, employed only as auxiliary data

Japanese.reason: referred to as the spoken language of transcripts and actor instructions, used for textual modality but not studied
